name: Nalmexone
summary: Nalmexone (INN; also known as nalmexone hydrochloride (USAN) or by the development codes EN-1620A and UM-592) is a semisynthetic, opioid partial agonist or mixed agonist-antagonist with both analgesic and narcotic antagonist properties that was never marketed. In clinical studies it was found to have comparable analgesic efficacy to morphine, though with several-fold reduced potency.

pharmacology.text: Nalmexone (INN; also known as nalmexone hydrochloride (USAN) or by the development codes EN-1620A and UM-592) is a semisynthetic, opioid partial agonist or mixed agonist-antagonist with both analgesic and narcotic antagonist properties that was never marketed.

uses.text: Nalmexone (INN; also known as nalmexone hydrochloride (USAN) or by the development codes EN-1620A and UM-592) is a semisynthetic, opioid partial agonist or mixed agonist-antagonist with both analgesic and narcotic antagonist properties that was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the mixed opioid agonist-antagonists, can cause drowsiness, dizziness, nausea and sometimes unpleasant mood changes, and can bring on withdrawal in people dependent on other opioids.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片混合促效拮抗劑，可能引起嗜睡、頭暈、噁心，有時會出現不愉快的情緒變化，並可能讓依賴其他鴉片類藥物的人出現戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片混合促效拮抗剂，可能引起嗜睡、头晕、恶心，有时会出现不愉快的情绪变化，并可能让依赖其他鸦片类药物的人出现戒断反应。

fact.en: The nal at the start of its name is shared by naloxone, naltrexone and nalorphine, and marks drugs that partly or fully block opioid receptors.
fact.zh: 名稱開頭的「nal」與納洛酮、納曲酮和烯丙嗎啡相同，代表這類藥物會部分或完全阻斷鴉片受體。
fact.zhHans: 名称开头的「nal」与纳洛酮、纳曲酮和烯丙吗啡相同，代表这类药物会部分或完全阻断鸦片受体。
